title: Engineering Manager, Android - Quick Commerce
searchText: Engineering Manager, Android - Quick Commerce Delivery Hero Company Description Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 70 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description We’re hiring an Senior Engineering Manager, Android to join the Quick Commerce Global Services team, powering Delivery Hero - based in Glovo, Barcelona. YOUR MISSION In this role, you’ll be part of a central team within Delivery Hero’s Global Services unit, shaping solutions that serve our entire global ecosystem, and your work will drive impact across Delivery Hero’s regional brands worldwide. You’ll be working with cross-functional teams to build scalable solutions that enhance customer experiences and operational excellence on a global scale. It’s a unique opportunity to combine Glovo’s vibrant, fast-paced culture with the reach and complexity of one of the world’s largest local delivery platforms. THE JOURNEY Make impactful decisions : Take ownership of them, while demonstrating collaborative problem-solving skills. Ensure the high reliability of a low-latency high-throughput system that powers the delivery fees of 60+ countries and all Delivery Hero brands Lead a high-performing team : You will lead a cross-functional team of more than 10 engineering professionals. Collaborate effectively : You will partner closely with Product Heroes to deliver business-critical services. Drive operational excellence : You will leverage cutting-edge practices, Own the tech metrics and KPIs of your team, ensuring full visibility, tracking, and alerting Provide technical support for the design of solutions that are reliable, performing, cost-effective, and scalable to meet the business needs. Qualifications An engineering background with the capability to assess complex technical decisions, pinpoint potential technical issues, and devise effective solutions. Demonstrated experience in independently leading teams, proactively seeking opportunities for advancement within your area of expertise in collaboration with your product counterpart. 2+ years of experience in guiding, empowering, and mentoring Engineering Managers, as well as Staff Engineers, in enhancing their leadership skills. Technical Background: Strong foundational knowledge of native mobile app development using Kotlin, solid experience with Android Architecture Patterns, Coroutines Flow, and Modularisation. Be a leader and a model, setting high standards for engineering excellence, performance, scalability and security by example. Accountability for projects or applications of high complexity and traffic, including experience in constructing large-scale distributed systems and familiarity with incident management protocols. A keen eye for engineering productivity, with the ability to identify and address bottlenecks, ensuring frequent and high-quality deliverables. Nice to Have: Possess a mindset aligned with continuous deployment, agile methodologies, cloud-based infrastructures, and a strong emphasis on experimentation and testing. A deep passion for influencing and evolving the engineering culture within an expanding team. Qualifications Additional Information Here at Glovo, we thrive on diversity, we believe it enhances our teams, products, and culture. We know that the best ideas come from a mashup of brilliant diverse minds. This is why we are committed to providing equal opportunities to talent from all backgrounds – all genders, racial/diverse backgrounds, abilities, ages, sexual orientations and all other unique characteristics that make you YOU. We will encourage you to bring your authentic self to work, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels heard. Feel free to note your pronouns in your application (e.g., she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc). So, ready to take the wheel and make this the ride of your life? Delve into our culture by taking a peek at our Instagram and check out our Linkedin and website !
